title: Generative AI in Turbulence: Foundations, Applications, Validations and Benchmarks
abstract: arXiv:2610.35123v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generative AI offers new approaches to turbulence problems in which incomplete observations or unresolved d.o.f. admit multiple physically plausible solutions. Potential applications include stochastic closures, super-resolution, data assimilation, uncertainty quantification, and the generation of Eulerian and Lagrangian flow ensembles. However, turbulence is not a conventional image-generation problem. Its multiscale dynamics, intermittency, extreme events, rough velocity fields and intrinsically stochastic transport make visual realism, pointwise error, and low-order spectral agreement insufficient measures of physical fidelity. We examine where generative AI provide novel capabilities with emphasis on diffusion models, score-based methods, and related probability-transport formulations. translated_title: 湍流中的生成式人工智能：基础、应用、验证与基准测试
translated_abstract: 生成式人工智能为湍流问题提供了新的解决思路，这类问题中不完整的观测数据或未解析的自由度会对应多种物理上合理的解。其潜在应用包括随机闭合模型、超分辨率、数据同化、不确定性量化，以及欧拉坐标系和拉格朗日坐标系下流场集合的生成。然而，湍流并非一个常规的图像生成问题。其多尺度动力学、间歇性、极端事件、粗糙的速度场以及内在的随机输运特性，使得视觉逼真度、逐点误差和低阶谱一致性等指标不足以衡量物理保真度。本文考察了生成式人工智能能够提供新颖能力的应用场景，重点关注扩散模型、基于分数的方法以及相关的概率输运公式。我们讨论了它们在无条件生成、概率重构、降阶建模、时间演化以及无网格表示方面的应用。
tldr: 本文系统评述了以扩散模型和基于分数的方法为代表的生成式人工智能在湍流研究中的基础、应用、验证与基准，指出由于湍流的多尺度性、间歇性和随机性等特殊性质，传统图像生成的评价指标不足以衡量物理保真度，需要建立专门的验证标准与基准测试。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically reviews the foundations, applications, validations, and benchmarks of generative AI in turbulence research—with emphasis on diffusion models and score-based methods—arguing that turbulence's multiscale dynamics, intermittency, and intrinsic stochasticity render conventional image-generation metrics insufficient, thus requiring dedicated physical fidelity validation standards and benchmarks.
